ValidationRule.description: Closeout_Photos_Attached__c must be true before status can change to Pending Closeout Approval.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Pending Closeout Approval"), NOT(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Pending Closeout Approval")), NOT(Closeout_Photos_Attached__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Closeout photos must be attached before submitting for approval. Upload photos of the completed installation before changing status.
